Terrible experience here. I called 4 times over the past couple weeks jussst to be safe before bringing my dog Rosie here for a grooming. I had just drove up 2 hours from San Diego and had no where to bring her. I ended up having to leave her in my car for 5 hours by herself in a parking garage. Your place is a joke. Where’s real management? No one is on the same page. No integrity. Get better systems in place and get your act together!

I dropped my dog off well before 10:00am and I’m writing this at 3:35pm. She still isn’t done. I came in around 2:00pm because I was worried and noticed they had just put her on the table. I’ve now been waiting in my car for another hour and a half.
When I went back inside, they told me she still needed another 30 minutes. I asked if it’s normal for a dog to be at the groomer for six hours. The cashier explained that groomers work on commission and make a percentage of the total, which made it clear that Andrew took on more dogs than he could reasonably handle.
I was also charged an extra fee for my dog being “hard to handle,” which has never happened in the six months I’ve been coming here. It felt like an unnecessary charge added to increase commission.
To make matters worse, while I was there, I witnessed another groomer make a dog’s nail bleed.
This experience felt disorganized, money-driven, and stressful for both pets and owners. I will not be returning.

I do want to say the manager was very very kind. You can tell he’s a good person. I thank him very much for listening to my concerns.

I had a terrible experience getting my dog groomed here - he's a yorkie mix. My dog was returned to me with a super uneven trim, and matted hair on his face and hind legs. I was confused and asked for more cut off and it seemed to be a struggle for the groomer. I left unhappy and spoke with another groomer who answered the phone and called me a liar. They also told me the cut was uneven, because he wiggles. I then asked how they were able to give him a decent cut in the past and not today. They told me the person who had previously cut his hair put him in unsafe and dangerous situations, and they had recently let him go. I was upset, because my dog was a foster up until recently. The person on the phone was rude and got angry and put me on hold without saying anything to connect me to a manager. The manager then gave me a $5 discount which they called "generous," after they confessed to putting my foster puppy in a dangerous situation in the past, and returning him to me with an uneven trim and hair knots. I paid but I don't feel as I should've been charged or spoken to disrespectfully.
